title: RAG token & cost budget
prompt: Each query retrieves the top 5 chunks (~500 tokens each), plus a ~500-token system prompt, a ~100-token question, and a ~500-token answer. LLM cost is $5 per 1M tokens.

bands.label: Total tokens per query
bands.metWhy: ≈3,600 tokens — the retrieved context (5 × 500 = 2,500) dominates, which is exactly why chunk size × K is the lever you tune for cost and latency.
bands.why: Add it up: 5 chunks × 500 + 500 system prompt + 100 question + 500 answer ≈ 3,600. The retrieval context is the dominant term — that's the insight.

bands.label: Cost per 1,000 queries (USD)
bands.metWhy: ≈$18 per 1,000 queries. At scale the retrieved context, not the answer, is what drives your bill — shrinking K or chunk size is the cheapest win.
bands.why: 3,600 tokens/query × 1,000 = 3.6M tokens; at $5 per 1M that's ≈$18. Notice the context tokens, not the answer, dominate the cost.
